scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in ivory robes and an ochre mantle sits on a limestone terrace, holding a blank scroll and looking upward. Olive branches frame him; winding roads connect distant hilltop settlements beneath blue-gray clouds. Clay vessels and a basket of figs rest nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The prophet, blank scroll and distant settlements form an imagined setting for the LORD's word coming to Jeremiah against the nations. The verse specifies no location, posture, writing scene or particular nations. These visual details suggest attentive reception and the message's outward scope, rather than a documented moment. God is not depicted.
